description: Lignes souterraines Basse Tension (BT) is a dataset listed in SRD OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SRD. Ce jeu de données représente la position des lignes souterraines Basse Tension (BT) sur l'ensemble du réseau de distribution exploité par SRD. Le système de projection utilisé est le Lambert 93 (référence nationale). Ces données sont restituées sous la forme de découpage en segments. Coverage: Vienne (SRD electricity network). The portal files it under Cartographie des réseaux. Its keywords are Lignes, Souterrain, Basse Tension, BT, Cartographie. The portal shows 89,394 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-srd-energies-fr-portal.
